What is performing well

  • Core 30-day CPL improved to $53.37 in the supplied source.
  • Meta and Google Display contributed to stronger Core performance.
  • Named awareness generated 4,007 site visits at 0.94% CTR.
  • Grocery and QSR were identified as stronger Named verticals.
  • StackAdapt delivered a 90.42% video completion rate.

What could be optimized further

  • YouTube had minimal delivery and no conversion in the last 30 days; review bids and channel role.
  • Named CPL remains an efficiency focus despite week-over-week improvement.
  • SysAdmin Day CPL was higher than the prior run in the source; additional creative was being considered.
  • Continue improving Search traffic quality and expanding non-brand coverage.
These are in-flight optimization areas—not implementation failures. The report intentionally avoids presenting data-quality / CAPI work as campaign underperformance.

INSIGHTS & ACTION PLAN

A balanced story: momentum, watch areas and next moves

Observed evidence is separated from proposed action so the report remains credible and does not frame implementation issues as campaign failure.

Protect momentum

Scale what is working

  • Continue prioritizing efficient Core Meta and Google campaigns / creative.
  • Maintain Named focus on Grocery and QSR while expanding relevant vertical creative.
  • Use Named CS CQ and account-volume signals to personalize follow-up.
  • Keep Core open-campaign reporting focused on delivery, audience and content response.
Optimize deliberately

Address selected watch areas

  • Review YouTube bids and channel role given minimal delivery and no recent conversion.
  • Continue improving Named CPL while preserving awareness and account reach.
  • Refresh SysAdmin creative where feasible and monitor CPL through the scheduled conclusion.
  • Continue Search traffic-quality work and non-brand keyword expansion.
Close visibility gaps

Complete the operating picture

  • Supply Core and Named targets / completion dates to unlock remaining-volume and finish forecasts.
  • Export site/app, geography and device delivery for deeper placement visibility.
  • Provide account/IP-level exposure only if a supported paid data source is available.
  • Refresh the Paid Media source period and operational status before each client share.
Bottom line: the supplied data shows more working than not. Core acquisition efficiency is improving, Named is generating broad paid engagement and matched CS delivery, and the report identifies a small number of credible optimization priorities without overstating risk.
Draft actions require Avani review, feasibility confirmation and scoping before client delivery.
90-second client readoutThe campaign is showing more momentum than risk.

Core acquisition efficiency improved in the supplied source, Named is producing broad paid engagement and fully matched CS delivery, and the report identifies a focused set of next moves rather than an inflated list of problems. The immediate operating priority is to protect efficient Core activity, build on stronger Named verticals, address YouTube and Search-quality watch areas, and confirm the remaining forecast / serving inputs needed for a complete forward view.
